subject: Milestone roadmap checkpoint: owners, blockers, and updated target
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@alfarix.com>, Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@alfarix.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Milestone roadmap checkpoint & MAP v2 (post-demo)

Hi Tara / Ben —

Thanks again for a productive demo today. Per our call, I attached an updated milestone roadmap (ALFARIX_MAP_v2.xlsx) that captures the items we talked through. High-level recap and proposed owners below: 

- Week 0 (Nov 22): Contract kickoff + SSO scoping — Owner: Alfarix (Ben) / Redwood (Stephanie)
- Week 1 (Nov 29): EHR connector approval (dependency: their vendor security review) — Owner: Alfarix (Tara)
- Week 2: Technical intake + sandbox provisioning — Owner: Redwood (Aditya)
- Week 3–4: Integration sprint + validation tests — Owner: Joint
- Target pilot launch: Dec 20, 2026 (prelim) — dependent on EHR sign-off and DocuSign completion

Open items (we flagged on call):
1) Procurement: Alfarix needs our standard SOW and a preliminary TCO.
2) Security/compliance: they requested our SOC 2 overview and the integration security checklist.
3) EHR connector vendor sign-off — this is a hard blocker for Week 1.

Next steps from Redwood: we will attach the integration requirements doc and a lightweight SOW template by EOD Wednesday. Can you confirm who on your side will shepherd the vendor approval and procurement?

Thanks — looking forward to the checkpoint next week.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ALFARIX_MAP_v2.xlsx

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@alfarix.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@alfarix.com>, RFP Team <procurement@alfarix.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone roadmap checkpoint & MAP v2 (post-demo)

Thanks Stephanie — that summary looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Vendor approval for the EHR connector: I will own this and kick off the security questionnaire. We need Redwood's integration checklist to populate with endpoint/IP ranges.
- Procurement: Ben will work with our procurement team; they want a draft SOW and a ballpark cost for the pilot by next Tuesday (Nov 24).
- Pilot date: Dec 20 is ambitious but feasible if vendor sign-off completes on time. If not, we should set a soft target of Jan 10 as fallback.

Can Aditya/Marcus confirm the expected lead time to stand up a sandbox and whether there are any capacity constraints for a pilot slot in late Dec? Also please send the SOC 2 summary and the integration checklist.

On the map file: we made a couple of inline comments in the attached XLSX — will send the annotated copy after Ben reviews.

Best,
Tara
VP, Platform Integrations
Alfarix Health

Date: 2026-11-20T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone roadmap checkpoint & MAP v2 (post-demo)

Hi Tara — great to meet you virtually. Quick answers to your questions: 

- Sandbox provisioning: we can provision a dedicated sandbox within 3 business days after we receive the integration form and IP allowlist. No capacity constraints anticipated for a pilot in late Dec; we will mark a pilot slot as tentative until we have the vendor approval.
- Integration checklist: attached (integration_requirements.pdf). It has the fields your security team typically requests: network, auth, data retention, sample payloads, and test vectors.
- SOC 2: we have a one-page SOC 2 summary we can circulate; Stephanie will attach it to the HubSpot deal record.

Action items (Redwood):
- Deliver sample SOW and pilot cost ballpark — Stephanie (due Nov 24)
- Share SOC 2 summary and the integration checklist — Aditya (shared now)
- Reserve pilot sandbox slot (tentative) — Marcus

Let us know if you want a technical sync next week (I can join).

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@alfarix.com>
Cc: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@alfarix.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Milestone roadmap checkpoint — quick weekly nudge + MAP v3

Hi Tara / Ben —

Gentle nudge ahead of our weekly checkpoint. I've attached a revised MAP (ALFARIX_MAP_v3.xlsx) that includes: 
- Updated owners column (Aditya added technical owners and Marcus added pilot ops)
- Clearer dependencies: EHR vendor approval now marked "blocking" with a highlighted owner and expected due date Nov 24
- New column for deliverables (SOW, SOC 2 summary, sandbox creds)

Status at a glance: 
- Procurement: Ben -> procurement intro pending (Ben to confirm by EOD)
- Security: Tara -> questionnaire started; Redwood shared checklist
- Sandbox: tentative slot reserved; final provisioning depends on completed integration form

Please reply with any changes or confirm if we should move the target pilot date to Jan 10 as a contingency. If we don't hear back by Tue EOD (Nov 23), we'll assume the Nov 24 vendor approval is on track and proceed with the Dec 20 tentative slot.

Thanks — I'll run the weekly sync on Wed 11/24 at 10am PT unless otherwise noted.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
